question: By whose agency does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker states that they have become known or have come to know.
This knowing is said to occur by the grace of the addressee.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
uncertainties: The verb nuance between 'known' and 'have come to know' remains context-dependent.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
